reason: I only try a new place if someone I know recommended it or I saw good Google reviews, and I have neither here. Going out just to wash and then waiting around for the dryer feels like a chore, so I would put it off.
objection: I don't know anyone who has used it and I have no reviews to go on. R$ 42 plus the trip and the waiting is a lot of effort for one duvet.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or neighbour telling me it is clean and the machines work well, or a good number of positive Google reviews.
